base: S08 final frozen production inputs on main be9e298; seven S05 files differ, no Git commit

source.boundary: S08 final frozen inputs; seven S05 simulation/UI inputs differ. No history deletion, no stats/observer/telemetry mutation.

logic.method: Same frozen production inputs except the seven S05 files; all serialized World/account/events/RNG plus production/receipt UI and query results. Only the three established run UUID fields normalized. Diagnostic historical records retained.

cpu.method: Serial alternating A/B rounds. Setup and history creation excluded from hot timings. Cold timings include first index build; heap measured after forced GC. Local CPU only, not frame FPS.

consumers.method: Independent serial alternating CPU measurements after browser closes. Native active reservations, tactical facilities UI and reinforcement pool weights; no frame-rate claim.

decisions.result: Retain full pods and economic records. Ledger job lookup is indexed, including queen injection; no blanket skip of destroyed pods: they can still release pending guards. A/B control proves both pending guards release once with guardianPod=null. Economic-record and historical-pod traversal remain; no memory compaction claim.

Read the previous two draft-history records directly rather than copy all preceding history first. 0/1/2/3/20/1000/10000 histories include shown/chosen weighting and actual offers/RNG equality. Preserve complete history.

Derived index by ledger array identity: append indexes once, settled jobs leave only the work set, full historical array and first-ID lookup remain. Cold build and extra Map memory measured. No receipt/purchase-history deletion; observer still needs all new orders, U04 unchanged.

Share active-delivery queries for production, paid/body/tactical reservations, twin pending lookup, refunds, retirement and delivery. Read current passenger/body state each time; no cached counts across same-tick deaths or cargo mutation. Both UI consumers share these queries.

Two living twins clear regrowth/birth-pending and return before ledger lookup. Missing/dead partner still checks waiting cargo and original recovery rules. Proxy test proves zero ledger access for healthy twins.

Keep existing ordered Boss loot settlement and repeated queue filtering. These transitions may acquire units, change later eligibility or retain blocked retries. No independent optimization adopted or new speedup claimed; original source input is unchanged and full regression covers immediate/blocked/transition/idempotent settlement.

Keep native purchase/claim army-stat refresh. Real building/cards/equipment and arrivals can alter recipients and subsequent eligibility. No dynamic stat cache or notification coalescing in S05; unchanged source plus full regression is the retained control, not a measured optimization.

items.resolution: Use visibility assertions; baseline-5 reuses this loaded browser but resets all four World fixtures before formal captures, then closes it. No FPS comparison uses this reused session.

items.resolution: Fourth runner also incorrectly waited for DOM removal and timed out on the hidden node. Final runner waits for hidden state; production and diagnostic bundles unchanged.

items.resolution: Select the first existing close button explicitly. Original report, runner and screenshots retained; same game and diagnostic builds.

failures.note: All measurement samples, including sub-microsecond short-history overhead and unchanged general UI variation, retained. Extra derived index costs memory and one cold scan.
